Placemaker.LogisticsYard.Name: Logistics yard
Placemaker.Recipe.LogisticsYard.Descript: A storage and loading yard laid out like a parking lot: container stacks, pallets, crates or lumber in blocks between drive aisles, truck loading bays, sheds and floodlights.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.style.Tooltip: What fills the storage blocks. Mixed varies the goods from block to block.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.aisleWidth.Tool: Width of the drive aisles between the storage blocks (forklifts need 4 m, trucks 8 m or more).
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.blockDepth.Tool: Depth of each storage block between two aisles. Deeper blocks hold more rows.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.blockLength.Too: Length of a storage block before the next cross aisle.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.fill.Tooltip: Share of the storage slots that hold goods. Lower looks like a yard mid-shift.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the aisle grid against the area's long axis.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.dockSide.Toolti: Where the truck loading bays go: the edge far from the entrance (back), near it (front), two edges, or none.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.trucks.Tooltip: Share of the loading bays with a truck or trailer backed in.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.sheds.Tooltip: Warehouse sheds or lean-tos along the edge behind the loading bays.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.machines.Toolti: Forklifts, reach stackers and yard tractors per hectare, working the aisles.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.gatehouse.Toolt: A guard booth and boom barrier at the main entrance.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.office.Tooltip: A site office cabin next to the entrance lane.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.markings.Toolti: Painted aisle lines, block outlines and bay lines (hard ground only).
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.stains.Tooltip: Oil, dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², in clumps.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard so stacks stand flat, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent).
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.buffer.Tooltip: A planted strip of this width between the outline and the yard.
Placemaker.LogisticsYard.Issue.NoBuffer: Logistics yard: the area is too narrow for the green buffer; the yard fills it all.
Placemaker.AddOn.YardBreak.Name: Break area
Placemaker.AddOn.YardBreak.cabin.Tooltip: A cabin or shed for the yard crew.
